wishPlaceholder: Assign a task or describe an automatic rule (e.g. file new drafts in 00-Inbox, ignore bills under $50)...
ambientPaused: Automatic rules are paused · Manual tasks and chat remain active
ambientIdle: No active automatic rules · Type a goal below to run in the background
ambientPending: {{active}} rule(s) active · {{pending}} action(s) waiting for confirmation
quickPokeMorningWish: Check my persistent memory goals, 00-Inbox, and active workspaces, then generate a concise summary for today.
quickPokeInboxWish: Check ~/Documents/KnowledgeBase/00-Inbox for unorganized drafts and file them cleanly.
quickPokeAuditWish: Check active workspaces and background tasks; summarize only items needing my attention.
emptyInbox: No new updates. Unchanged routine checks are skipped automatically in the background.
emptyApprovals: Nothing waiting for confirmation. Outbound or irreversible actions pause here before running.
emptyMissions: No active automatic rules yet. Enable a starter above or click New Rule to create one in plain words.
emptyWorkers: No background subtasks yet. Tasks delegated across workspaces appear here.
inlineReplyPlaceholder: Add a note or next step (e.g. draft a reply, archive this)...
tasteUpSaved: Preference saved: will keep notifications like this
tasteDownSaved: Filter added: similar low-priority updates will be muted
tasteRulePlaceholder: Optional filter rule (e.g. ignore bills under $50)...
trustHint: Confirmed {{count}} time(s) previously — you can switch this rule to run automatically
approvalNotePlaceholder: Optional note or reason for declining (saved for future runs)...

presetWebhookDesc: Expose a local HTTP endpoint for Shortcuts, scripts, or external alerts.
presetMorningDesc: Summarize active goals, inbox items, and workspace todos every morning.
